services.desc: Our Fishing Season begins May 1, through November 30th. All equipment, bait, fishing rods, are provided on all Charters. Charters are not available on Mondays. Saltwater Fishing Rhode Island for Fluke, Black Fish, Scup, Striped Bass, Cod fish, Seabass The most popular trips because they offer a reasonable amount of time for travel to the fishing grounds, time to find and catch fish and return to the dock. We depart around 6:00 am and return around 1:30 pm. This fishing trip is a combination of trolling and bottom fishing and is the most popular trip we offer.
